designScoreNote: 4.00 mean at close. All 19 findings closed; no high-impact finding open, so the B cap does not apply. The score is a STATIC score — see unverified.

findings.summary: Android back unhandled on the alarm screen; a reflex press backgrounded the app mid-alarm
No screen scrolled and no display font-scale ceiling; large Dynamic Type clipped content unreachably
Untokenised rgba textShadow on the map lockup
Search clear and clear-destination Pressables had no pressed state
Gear pictograph in the dev-only simulate button, against the app's own no-emoji rule
20 distinct font sizes once inline overrides were counted; scale collapsed to 10 with zero inline fontSize
Font packages imported from their roots bundled 30 .ttf to use 6; switched to weight subpaths (assets 4.0MB -> 1.7MB)
findings.lens: mobile-app-ui-design (2 weights max) surfaced the dead faces

findings.summary: 14 spacing values off the 4pt grid; snapped to the scale
Dismissing the alarm kept the destination, dropping an arrived user onto a card offering to wake them where they stood; the ending now clears it
Interface icons drifted across 1.9/2/2.2/2.4 stroke against the set's own documented 1.9; standardised, and brand marks split into a separate documented class
Pressed states were colour-only and instant; added a native-driven press-scale that respects reduce motion
findings.lens: taste-skill (no active/pressed feedback) — agrees with tell #35

findings.summary: Every surface was a flat fill; the paper now carries a seeded 128px grain at 4.5%, so a printed ticket reads as printed
Hardcoded maxWidth 190 truncated Hebrew station names on wider phones; replaced with flexShrink

Four shipped palette values failed WCAG AA as text (paperMuted 2.27:1, signalOnPaper 2.44:1, rail 3.74:1, paperSub 4.15:1); solved by holding hue and saturation and moving lightness until each cleared 4.5:1

No light mode, and none was possible: tokens were named after the material (ink/paper/rail) so every component hard-coded one. Added a palette -> schemes indirection with two Surface sets per scheme and a real day scheme that is a second material rather than an inversion

Saved destinations were designed and stringed but never built; the i18n keys had shipped with no code behind them. Built as a strip of torn ticket stubs above the setup sheet, restoring place AND radius

removeSaved was defined in the store and never called, so a mis-saved stop was permanent until the 12-item cap pushed it out; added long-press to delete behind a confirm, with the hint on the accessibility label
The new SavedStrip set fontSize inline, re-opening FINDING-006 in the same commit that closed the feature; moved to type.bodyStrong. Caught by the close-out regression, not by review
The type scale's own doc comment still claimed nine sizes after the collapse landed ten

dismissed.reason: ScrollView wraps a map over results capped at 5 in GeocodingService.search; the tell explicitly permits bounded lists
single Alert.alert, guarding the destructive cancel — the sanctioned use
arrow glyph is inside a code comment, not user-visible
4 em-dashes in Hebrew strings; the em-dash is standard Hebrew punctuation, the tell targets English LLM copy tics
0 shadowColor anywhere; the signage system has no shadows
0 inline hex outside src/theme after FINDING-003
standDown() enumerates and clears geofence, location task, scheduled + presented notifications, audio session and storage
ScrollView over saved stubs capped at MAX = 12 in SavedStorage; bounded list, and a horizontal strip of 12 does not warrant FlatList overhead
ScrollView over a fixed 3-card board, not a data list
Alert.alert guards the destructive delete — the sanctioned use
Alert.prompt names a saved stop on iOS; documented platform divergence, Android falls back to the destination's own label

dismissed.where: borderRadius 4.5/5/8/13/58 across ui, DestinationMap, SavedStrip, AlarmScreen
dismissed.reason: every one is exactly half its element's size — station nodes, perforation punches, the alarm target. Circles by nature, which is the documented exception to the square-corners rule; no rounded rectangle anywhere

dismissed.where: SavedStrip stubs use a pressed fill rather than usePressScale
dismissed.reason: a scale animation on an item inside a horizontal ScrollView fights the scroll gesture; a pressed fill is the correct feedback there and is still real feedback

unverified: No simulator, emulator or device was reachable: dl.google.com and api.expo.dev are blocked by the environment's network policy, so no Android SDK and no EAS build.

NOT verified on a device: keyboard avoidance, splash-to-first-frame transition, scroll performance, actual font-scale rendering at 1.3x, edge-to-edge insets, haptic firing, alarm audibility, geofence delivery.
First-impression narration and Trunk Test were not run — they are live-pass instruments and a static review cannot fake them.

The day scheme has not been seen rendered. Its contrast ratios were computed, not observed, and Apple Maps' own light appearance under userInterfaceStyle='light' is unverified against the ticket paper.
secondLens: ceorkm/mobile-app-ui-design — run as a second, differently-opinionated pass
dismissedFromSecondLens: Use emojis/illustrations for personality — contradicts the approved direction's rule 3 and tell #1; every mark in this app is drawn SVG.
rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl cards — contradicts rule 1 (square corners only) and tell #11.
Glows, white inner shadows on buttons, 5% accent borders — the signage system has no shadows by design; adding them is the generic-premium look the direction rejects.
Tailwind / Lucide / Recharts implementation notes — wrong stack; this is React Native StyleSheet.
Sleep/Meditation convention: purple and deep blue — the user chose signal orange on ink.
60/30/10: accent is 20% of colour REFERENCES, but that is not surface area — the alarm screen is a deliberate full flood counted as one reference. Not actionable as measured.

Max 4 font sizes: landed at 10, not 4. A system with a display voice, a Hebrew text voice and a departures-board mono register cannot honestly reach 4; halving it and removing every one-off was the real win.
thirdLens: Leonxlnx/taste-skill — the web-scoped upstream that draftbit adapted for RN
dismissedFromThirdLens: Accent saturation <=80%: signal orange measures S=100%. Deliberate — it is a signal colour on rail signage and the alarm flood is meant to scream. Also an approved brand decision, not mine to re-litigate.

One grey family only: rail greys are cool (H~220), paper greys warm (H~37). Both are present, but they never share a ground — greys relate to the surface they sit on, and mixing them WITHIN a surface is what the rule is actually about.
No random dark section in a light page: the wake pass is all-paper while other screens are ink. Systematic, not a copy-paste accident — it is the ticket metaphor.
Glassmorphism, spotlight borders, mesh gradients, variable-font and scroll-driven motion: web techniques, and several contradict the approved direction and the anti-slop catalog.
Font suggestions (Geist, Outfit, Satoshi, Cabinet Grotesk): none carry Hebrew. Heebo and Assistant were chosen for exactly that reason.
404 pages, cookie consent, meta tags, skip-to-content, smooth scroll, semantic HTML, z-index scale: web-only, no analogue in React Native.
Lorem Ipsum / Acme / John Doe / round numbers: none present; copy is real Hebrew throughout.
run: regression — mobile-redesign-app, preserve-language mode (2nd run against this baseline)

delta.against: the 2026-09-01 pre-rebuild baseline (13 findings, all fixed)
delta.categories: no letter changed — every category was already A and none regressed
delta.note: The two high findings were invisible to the first pass because it graded the system that existed: a single-scheme app cannot fail dark-mode parity, and contrast was assumed rather than measured. Building the second scheme is what made both measurable. FINDING-018 is the regression pass earning its keep — the rebuild broke a rule the rebuild had set.
